title: fix(app-shell): a ⌘K built-in command is found by the words of its own label

Fixes #33061

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么:⌘K 命令面板里的内置命令(「Open Full Search Page」和三个主题命令)现在也按用户看到的标签文字来匹配,而且是当前语言的标签。原来的英文隐藏值照旧能搜到。
- 为什么改:原来只拿隐藏的英文值去匹配,所以输入 `open` 或 `full search` 找不到写着这两个词的那一行;中文界面下输入「浅色」「完整搜索」也找不到「浅色主题」「打开完整搜索页面」。
- 风险与回滚:只改 app-shell 一个文件的匹配条件,命令只会被多搜到、不会少;回滚即还原本 PR。
- 先看:`ui/packages/app-shell/src/chrome/CommandPalette.tsx` 里 `themeCommands` 与 `showFullSearch` 两行。
- 两分钟验证:在 Console 按 ⌘K,输入 `open`,预期出现「Open Full Search Page」;切到中文输入「浅色」,预期出现「浅色主题」。
- 需要你做的:无,席位落地。

## What changes

`ui/packages/app-shell/src/chrome/CommandPalette.tsx`:

- The full-search command is matched by its rendered, localized label (`console.commandPalette.openFullSearch`) beside its value `search all results full page`. The label is read once (`fullSearchLabel`) and the same string is both matched and drawn.
- The three theme commands are matched by their rendered labels (`themeLabel[theme]`) beside their values (`theme light`, …). This is the same defect class in the same file, folded in as a bounded in-place fix (os-dev.md rule 3, all four conditions hold) after the seat amended the claim's file surface to "the built-in commands' match".
- cmdk `value`s are unchanged, so selection, the studio scope and every existing pin that reads `data-value` are untouched. No English-only synonym is added: the words that find a command are its own label's words in the member's language, plus its value as before.
- Comments updated where they said built-in commands match "by their value".

New pin `ui/packages/app-shell/src/chrome/CommandPalette.commandLabelMatch-33061.test.tsx`, through the real `CommandPaletteProvider` (opened by `?palette=1`) under a real `I18nProvider`, typing into the palette's `cmdk-input`. Labels are read from the shipped locale packs (`@object-ui/i18n/locales`):

- `open` and `full search` find "Open Full Search Page" under `en`.
- Under `zh-Hans`, `完整搜索` finds 「打开完整搜索页面」 and `浅色` finds 「浅色主题」, each and only that row.
- CONTROL: `search` (a word of the value) still finds the full-search row; `invoice` (en) and `发票` (zh-Hans, read after the zh labels are drawn) find no command.

Root `.changeset/33061-palette-command-label-match.md`: `@object-ui/app-shell` + `@object-ui/console` patch (app-shell is private; the console's dist ships it, precedent `.changeset/32868-holder-pick-fallback-position-note.md`).

## Why

Measured on `origin/main` `2797f81d`: `showFullSearch = !inStudio && matches(FULL_SEARCH_VALUE)` and `THEME_COMMANDS.filter((command) => matches(command.value))`. `matchesPaletteQuery('open', ['search all results full page'])` is false (no word starts with `open`, and it is not a substring), and `full search` is not a contiguous run of the value. Ablation leg A below puts exactly that line back and the `open` / `full search` pin goes red, so the premise holds on the current tree.

## Tests

<details><summary>New pin + neighbouring palette pins (HEAD)</summary>

`pnpm exec vitest run --maxWorkers=2` on `CommandPalette.commandLabelMatch-33061`, `CommandPalette.navMatch-11812`, `CommandPalette.studioScope-11863`: Test Files 3 passed (3), Tests 21 passed (21), lock VERDICT command-exit 0.

</details>

<details><summary>Ablation (two legs, scripts/ablation-replace.mjs, restored to HEAD blob 35bcc9e44c10)</summary>

- Leg A, `matches(fullSearchLabel, FULL_SEARCH_VALUE)` → `matches(FULL_SEARCH_VALUE)` (the `origin/main` behaviour). On disk: label-match 0, value-only 1. Result: Tests 2 failed, 2 passed. `open`/`full search` red with `expected [] to deeply equal [ 'Open Full Search Page' ]`; zh-Hans red with `expected [] to deeply equal [ '打开完整搜索页面' ]`. Both CONTROLs green. Restored: blob == HEAD, `git diff HEAD` empty.
- Leg B, `matches(themeLabel[command.theme], command.value)` → `matches(command.value)`. On disk: label-match 0, value-only 1. Result: Tests 1 failed, 3 passed, the zh-Hans case red with `expected [] to deeply equal [ '浅色主题' ]`. Restored: blob == HEAD, `git diff HEAD` empty.

The test imports `./CommandPalette` from source, so no `dist/` build sits between the mutation and the run.

</details>

<details><summary>Affected package: app-shell suite and type-check (HEAD 9a6002da)</summary>

- `pnpm exec vitest run --maxWorkers=2 packages/app-shell/` (from `ui/`, under the verify lock): Test Files 2254 passed, 1 skipped (2255); Tests 20840 passed, 9 skipped (20849); VERDICT command-exit 0, held 1h15m.
- `pnpm --filter @object-ui/app-shell run type-check` after `pnpm --filter '@object-ui/app-shell^...' build`: exit 0.

</details>

## Acceptance notes

- No new i18n key: the existing `console.commandPalette.openFullSearch` / `lightTheme` / `darkTheme` / `systemTheme` rows are what is matched, so every shipped locale (11 packs) is covered by the same line. `Clause-②: no`, `Metadata-protocol: none` as claimed: app-shell is private and nothing authorable changes.
- A query now also finds a command when it hits its label's words. In `en` the theme labels hold the same words as their values, so nothing new finds them; the full-search row is newly found by `open` and by contiguous label runs such as `full search` or `open full`. In the other ten packs every command is newly found by its own label's words.
- Scoped `eslint --no-inline-config` on the two changed files: 0 errors; the 10 warnings are on untouched lines (89–97, 188, 249, 363, 428).
